data.one_liner: Embed Unity 3D in Flutter with a typed bridge and binary protocol.
data.what_it_does: Allows embedding Unity 3D as a platform view widget inside Flutter applications. Provides a two-way typed bridge, binary protocol, performance monitoring, AR Foundation integration, and asset streaming across Android, iOS, and Web.
use_when: You need to embed an interactive Unity 3D game or scene directly inside a Flutter layout
You require bi-directional typed messaging or high-frequency binary data exchange between Flutter and Unity
You are building cross-platform AR applications leveraging Unity AR Foundation from Flutter
avoid_when: You are building a 2D game in Flutter where pure Dart game engines like Flame are sufficient
You want a fully working out-of-the-box desktop embedded Unity player view (desktop embedding is currently work in progress)
strengths: Provides both JSON message routing and a high-performance binary protocol
Robust lifecycle state machine with automatic readiness guards and message queuing
Supports AR Foundation and live performance statistics streaming
weaknesses: Complex native setup steps required on both Android and iOS
Embedded Unity view is not yet fully implemented for desktop platforms (macOS, Windows, Linux)
data.setup_notes: Requires Android Gradle and settings modifications for the Unity library, iOS Podfile configuration, exporting and including the Unity project build files, and adding a FlutterBridge GameObject in Unity.

alternatives.name: flame
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose Flame if you want a pure Dart 2D game engine that does not require heavy native Unity setup or exporting.
